run_sunrgbd_converter: run the SUNRGB-D Total3D data converter to transform JSON annotations into pickle format for training
convert_sunrgbd_annotations: convert SUNRGB-D Total3D JSON annotation files to pickle format with transformed camera matrices and bounding boxes
transform_camera_matrices: transform camera rotation matrices from SUNRGB-D data following Total3DUnderstanding and DepthInstance3DBoxes coordinate conventions
extract_3d_boxes: extract 3D upright depth bounding boxes and class labels from SUNRGB-D Total3D annotations for 33 indoor object categories
process_sunrgbd_splits: process SUNRGB-D train and validation JSON splits and output corresponding pickle files via the CLI --path argument
